Japanese Shrine Garden

神社庭園（じんじゃていえん）

An exact 3D real-time replica of the viral demo created by @loktar00 on X.

Features & Mechanics

  • Original Audio Track: Atmospheric music generated with YuE2 + interactive procedural temple bells & water drops.
  • Dynamic Water Ripples: Falling sakura petals and user clicks generate interactive expanding concentric wave rings.
  • Authentic Shaders: 4x4 Bayer Matrix ordered dithering, color quantization/posterization, tilt-shift depth of field, and soft lantern bloom.
  • Procedural Architecture: Traditional Japanese Myōjin Torii gate, stone lanterns (Tōrō), Tsukubai water basin, and curved kawara-tiled shrine roof.
  • Dual Camera Modes: Switch between the exact 60-second video flythrough and free 360° orbital exploration.

Tip: Click on the pond to trigger ripples or click the 🔔 bell to ring the Japanese temple chime.
